protocol.data: Train Session1 only; temporal/subject pseudo-target, not cross-session evidence
protocol.known_outer_test: first 20% trials within each registered subject/task
protocol.inner: 2 pseudo-unknown groups; source last 60%, registered 20–40%, pseudo-unknown last 80%
protocol.model: full 4-second covariance Ridge only; window features passed unchanged but window/base scores are not evaluated
protocol.ea: per-task/band arithmetic SPD reference; source and target transformed by their own references
protocol.riemannian_recenter: per-task/band affine-invariant geometric mean by whitened tangent fixed-point iterations; not log-Euclidean
protocol.source_reference: fit_mask trials only, separately by task/band
protocol.target_reference: entire unlabeled eval batch, separately by task/band; no subject/session/known-unknown labels
protocol.features: restore shrinkage SPD from weighted log-cov upper triangles; recenter with R^-1/2 C R^-1/2; log-vectorize both source and target
protocol.aggregation: aggregate_reports plus equal-weight outer-fold macro means; worst fold selected by detection-macro-F1
protocol.precision: SPD eigensolvers and references use batched CUDA float64; Ridge uses existing float32 implementation
